dataNote: Operators in fixed broadband networks report to SUTEL the quantity of faults repaired within the time limit (threshold), in relation to the total reported faults. Therefore, considering a 100% compliance with indicator IC-2 of the Regulation for the Provision and Quality of Services and that the established threshold indicates that operators must address the fault within a maximum of 1 business day for 95% of cases, it is determined that the average time taken to attend customer fault reports for fixed broadband networks is 24 hours.
